title: Creative Strategy
summary: Overall new-customer ROAS was 0.75 against a goal above 0.8, so spend may come down before Black Friday while the team feeds the under-supplied secondary angles. AVIA output rose from 6 to 10 briefs a week and the new target is 20 briefs every three days, about 50 a week, at 0.85 NC ROAS. Real-footage AI drama ads now beat Pixar and claymation formats, and a $2,000 bonus goes to the first AI drama ad that spends over $20,000.
points: Blood sugar, cholesterol, prostate and neuro are validated but not growing because too few briefs feed them
More unaware ads wanted; the mix is too heavy on solution-aware
Real-footage AI drama and organic B-roll with voiceover outperform animation formats
Black Friday offer is in a two to three day A/B test; bottom-of-funnel creative already marked urgent for launch
Revised brain landing page and new mechanism are live
Statics: low CPC but off-target delivery; interest targeting as a suggestion proposed
Senior video editor being hired for training; weak editors to be reported in Slack
Editing tools moving from Higgsfield to Sume over about two months
decisions: AVIA target set at 20 briefs every three days, about 50 a week, with the new PDP
Creative for the new Black Friday offer can enter the pipeline now
$2,000 bonus for an AI drama ad spending over $20,000
Migrate editors from Higgsfield to Sume within about two months
Dusan refocuses on AVIA; Elissa shifts video briefs toward AVIA
